business_problem: AT&T wanted to put generative AI into everyday employee workflows so software developers, engineers, finance teams, supply chain staff, HR, customer service, and fraud teams could work faster on code, data analysis, support, and risk-related tasks while using a consistent internal architecture and keeping humans in the loop.
solution_summary: AT&T built Ask AT&T as an internal generative AI platform for employees and initially powered it with OpenAI's ChatGPT functionality, while keeping the system interoperable with other large language models including Meta's LLaMA 2 and Falcon transformers. The platform serves users through a conversational interface that accepts plain-English prompts for coding, question answering, and data analysis. AT&T feeds the system with enterprise content such as contracts, financial materials, HR information, AT&T content, software code, and network-related data so it can generate code, answer questions, and analyze operational data by detecting fields, joining tables, and creating code automatically. Beyond the employee-facing tool, AT&T uses NVIDIA RAPIDS AI software to accelerate Spark pipelines, Triton Inference Server to scale production AI/ML and Ask AT&T real-time inference, CuOpt for field technician routing optimization, and Riva for speech-to-text in front of GenAI applications, all aligned to a shared "single source of truth" architecture across common platforms, databases, and code.

solution_components.name: Falcon transformers
solution_components.role: They are additional open-source LLM options that Ask AT&T can use as part of its multi-model design.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA RAPIDS AI software
solution_components.role: It accelerates Spark data pipelines used in AT&T's AI and data workloads.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
solution_components.role: It scales production AI models and Ask AT&T question-and-answer inference for real-time use.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA CuOpt
solution_components.role: It performs more frequent vehicle routing optimization for AT&T field technicians.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Riva
solution_components.role: It provides speech-to-text in front of several generative AI applications.

data_flow: AT&T ingests enterprise content and operational data including software code, contracts, financial materials, HR information, AT&T content, and network data into Ask AT&T and related AI workflows. Employees query the system in natural language; the platform uses ChatGPT or alternative LLMs to generate code, answer questions, and analyze data, while RAPIDS accelerates Spark processing and Triton serves real-time inference on shared internal platforms and databases.
business_outcome: AT&T expanded AI access to more than 30,000 employees, accelerated coding and vulnerability remediation, enabled natural-language data analysis, improved Spark pipeline efficiency, and scaled real-time inference for production AI and internal question answering.
